target_policy: one confirmed spreadsheetId plus numeric sheetId plus exact title; whole dedicated sheet must be empty before claim
transaction_policy: preflight empty then local export then single claim then one PUT then independent GET; a claim is never issued twice
unknown_result_policy: read the exact bound range only; do not resend PUT, append, clear, or switch interface
reply_policy: reread A:F when the user approves and again immediately before every API or controlled-browser reply

authorization.token_input: injected in memory by an existing authorized Google workflow
authorization.optional_provider: existing google-auth Application Default Credentials only; not installed or configured by this skill
authorization.oauth_setup: outside this skill; hand off to the existing Google automation workflow

observed_local_cli.name: Google Workspace CLI
observed_local_cli.reason: cell values are supplied through a process argument and the upstream describes the CLI as an actively developed tool that is not an officially supported Google product
